notes.title: Ver1.0.10037 Enhanced Equip Button and Craft Menu
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing and for your feedback. 
In this update:

[b]Enhanced Equip Button:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can also use the Equip button to move HP recovery items to the Quick Use slot.
[*] When weapon slots are full, using the Equip button will replace the current selected weapon.
[/list]
Note that you can also use drag and drop to equip an item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44736988/94fdd93cc8ed37e36b35aff73aa561111a312a5f.png[/img]

[b]Enhanced Craft Menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Craft Menu now also shows items with insufficient materials.
[*] You can now check which materials are insufficient in the Craft Menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44736988/6e532de4cff0fe5b0c20fbd37fd8e316fe126bb4.png[/img]
[b]We also improved menu layouts and fixed bugs.[/b]

We will continue to improve the game, so if you have any opinions or questions, we would be grateful if you could contact us on the Steam community or Discord. 
Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing a New Feature: Collection Room!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce our latest feature: the Collection Room! This is a space where you can display any item from your inventory, arranged in any order you like. Be it weapons, materials, or artifacts, you can exhibit them all!

Invite your friends over to your Collection Room and let them admire your favorite items!

We’re continually adding more unique items to the inventory and constantly improving the game, so make sure to follow us and stay updated!
[previewyoutube=nTni-V38GpY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Adding a New Feature: Hit Combo
notes.notes:
I Just achieved my first 10 Hit Combo! Is it really a 10 Hit Combo? I made a slow-motion video for validation.
Check it out!
[previewyoutube=0O1throPwWQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3]How Hit Combo Works[/h3]
When a projectile from the player:
[list]
[*] Hits an enemy: +1
[*] Hits a wall/ore: Resets to zero
[*] Hits a wall/ore after hitting an enemy: No change
[*] Hits an enemy’s projectile: No change
[/list]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extra cores!
[*] Achievements!
[/list]
This feature can be toggled on or off in settings. Share your thoughts with us!
